context.transcript:
EKW
Thanks for tuning in to our podcast show, Food Advice.
In this week's episode, we're discussing an ordinary topic:
grocery shopping! One of the tips we'll share is how to
make a shopping list. It's important to make a list, since it
can save you a lot of time and money at the store. However,
before we begin, I'd like to remind you about our upcoming
raffle contest where we'll be giving away gift cards to several
lucky listeners. All you have to do to enter is post a review
of this episode to our podcast's social media site.
